title: 2,000 Bonus Flybuys Points (Worth $10) on $50 or $100 Ultimate Her, Him, Home, & $50 Ultimate Kids, Students Gift Cards @ Coles
body:
Deal: 2,000 Bonus Flybuys Points (Worth $10) on $50 or $100 Ultimate Her, Him, Home, & $50 Ultimate Kids, Students Gift Cards @ Coles

[Alrightm8] Keen to know if it’s max 5 per day? Thanks.
[King Steuart] My question is, is there a points cap for this deal? Usually it's around 15,000?
[WookieMonster] The bonus points you can earn through this deal is capped at 10,000, because:
The deal terms and conditions says you can only earn bonus points on a maximum of five gift cards per Flybuys account, and
You will earn 2,000 bonus points on the purchase of each eligible gift card.
[King Steuart] So that's not per flybuy account per day like normal gift card policy?
[WookieMonster] Approximately half the gift card deals at Coles involving Flybuys are for a set number of bonus points (e.g. 1000 bonus points, 2000 bonus points). Those deals are limited to five gift cards per account throughout the promotional period. Here is a recent example of these such deals.
The remaining gift card deals at Coles involving Flybuys are for earning a set number points per dollar (e.g. 10x points, 20x points). For those deals, they have a points limit associated with it and a sub-limit of 5 gift cards per day. Here is a recent example of these such deals.
Additionally, the everyday gift card limit is 5 gift cards per customer, and you will usually see signs for this at the top of the gift card shelf (e.g. like this ). These signs do not specifically mention a per-day limit, but a staff member will likely interpret this sign to mean per-day…
[polarq] Can this stack with https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/976238 ?
[mmrazz] No. Gift cards are excluded from that offer
[BargainBenno] 5 gift cards per flybuys account. So at $50 a card that is $250 worth per account. Still equivalent to $50 worth of points so 20 per cent off. I will have to set my alarm.
[team teri] Yes. The question is how high the risk is and how much effort it would take to get it sorted.
Maybe I need to hand back my ozBargain membership, but I took a 7% discount on eGift cards over the 10% for physical cards at Coles. Also convenient that I got $500 cards, didn't have to deal with 40 cards for a TV purchase, only 4…
But 20% gets me thinking…
[JoeOz] Thanks, I'll have to look out for any tampering
[Brick50] 5 per acct per day or for the entire promotion period?
[WookieMonster] It is five per account for the entire promotional period, because the terms and conditions very clearly says:
Limit 5 Gift Cards per Flybuys account.
… and …
BONUS POINTS can be awarded more than once for each Gift Card type including different denominations of the same Gift Card but can only be collected up to 5 times per Flybuys account.
If you think about it, the word "day" is not mentioned anywhere in the deal terms and conditions.
On the other hand, with the recent 20x points promotion on selected Ultimate gift cards at Coles, the clause in the terms and conditions referencing the purchase limit said something different:
BONUS POINTS can be awarded more than once for each Gift Card type including different denominations of the same Gift Card up to a maximum of 50,000 points per Flybuys account for the promotional period. NOTE: a purchase limit of 5 cards per customer per day applies.
[H3R34TH4C0MM3NTS] ok so you the maximum number of points you can get for this deal is 10000 which is $50 back in Coles credit is that right, you cant just come the next year day and score another 10000 points. this might be worthwhile to get GTA VI on a discount
[mwahahaha] Is it a better deal to get the $50 card?
[Gmaster] of course. one for every family member works well for us.
[SuHao] I’m not an expert with Flybuys. But generally in order to create a Flybuys account we only need to put phone number and email address right?
[Gmaster] Yes to phone number and email address. A phone number can be connected to multiple Flybuys accounts — an email address cannot.
[SuHao] @Gmaster: Do you know the maximum Flybuys accounts can be connected to the same phone number?
[xxssmmmmxx] @SuHao: I currently have four connected to the one phone number.
[Brick50] Can these be exchanged into JB hifi cards again? I remember buying close to 50 last year and could no longer exchange online, so I had to take them in store instead and swipe every card
[WookieMonster] At the moment, yes.
If you go to the Ultimate gift card website and choose the gift card you are interested in (e.g. Ultimate Him), you can see how each participating retailer accepts Ultimate gift cards. If you select the Exchange for eGift option, you can see that JB Hi-Fi is currently listed there.
Keep in mind that the redemption options can change at any time without prior notice. For example:
The Exchange for eGift option for JB Hi-Fi (and The Good Guys) was abruptly removed during this deal in late 2025 and did not come back until a number of weeks ago.
SHEIN was temporarily unavailable in September 2025, due to the exchange portal running out of SHEIN gift cards and Blackhawk Network not receiving a new supply of gift cards from the gift card supplier before stock ran out. (I know about this, because an OzBargainer contacted me about this for assistance.)
The Exchange for eGift option for Luxury Escapes was temporarily removed in August 2024, because some customers were experiencing technical issues trying to redeem Luxury Escapes gift cards on the Luxury Escapes website. During this period, Luxury Escapes only accepted Ultimate gift cards at one of their physical stores in Melbourne. (Yes, another OzBargainer contacted me about this for assistance.)
Additionally, Blackhawk Network is implementing limits on the number and/or dollar amount of Ultimate gift cards you can exchange in a 24 hour period. The Ultimate gift card terms and conditions refers to this limit in clause 4, plus you can find recent discussions on this topic here and here.
[Brick50] Very helpful, funnily enough that 2025 deal was the last one I participated in when the exchange option disappeared after I exchanged 22/44 already.
Was great fun using 22 JB gift cards and then swiping another 22 to buy my 17 Pro Max whilst the POS kept freezing on the poor employee

I already have some Apple GCs and I’m just a bit short, so was hoping to use a discounted Ultimate GC to top up the rest. I know the Ultimate T&Cs technically don’t allow buying other gift cards, but does JB Hi-Fi’s POS actually block it now?
